admissions.ageEligibility: Aged 10 to 12 on 31.03.2027: born between 01.04.2015 and 31.03.2017 (both dates inclusive).
admissions.selectionCriteria: Admission to Class VI is through the All India Sainik Schools Entrance Examination (AISSEE-2027), conducted by NTA on 31 January 2027 (pen and paper, OMR). Exam city slip from 11.01.2027 and admit card from 25.01.2027. The merit list is prepared school-wise and category-wise (home state and other states), separately for boys and girls. Minimum 25% marks in each section and 40% in aggregate (not applied to SC/ST candidates). Admission is by e-counselling on the AISSEE-2027 merit list, subject to medical fitness and document verification. Tentative Class VI vacancies in the bulletin: 100.

admissions.notes: From the NTA notice of 03.11.2026 and the AISSEE-2027 Information Bulletin (read 12 November 2026). Shri Bhawani Niketan Public School, Jaipur is an approved New Sainik School. 40% of its seats are filled from the all-India AISSEE-2027 merit list and 60% from its own students who qualify in AISSEE-2027. Boys/girls admission, fees, board and hostel follow the school's own policy; check its website before applying. Minimum 25% marks in each section and 40% in aggregate, for all candidates. Admission is by e-counselling on the AISSEE-2027 merit list, subject to medical fitness and document verification. Tentative Class VI vacancies in the bulletin: 120.
